# S0: Hero, the swarm and the glitch word

**Model:** Opus 5.5, high. **Paste to start:** `Read CLAUDE.md, then docs/build/STATUS.md and docs/build/scenes/S0.md, and do S0. Stop for my review at the key frames, and again at the end.`
**Spec:** `sed -n 204,240p PROTEST_VIZ_SPEC.md` (prologue layers + S0). Shared rules: [README.md](README.md).

## Purpose
Establish the roach as alive, unsettling and slightly comic, and "Cockroaches" as the title. This chat sets the visual tone and the shared swarm every prologue scene inherits.

## Allowed data keys
- `meta.title` ("Cockroaches"). Nothing else is shown.

## Files it owns
- `src/scenes/s00-hero.js` (+ `s00-hero.css` if needed).
- `src/roach/swarm.js`: **you set the swarm's model** (wander, cursor flee, pose fields). Keep `createSwarm`, `hash01`, `clear`, `draw` working; S3, S3.5 and S4 build on it.
- New `src/lib/glitch.js` if the glitch is worth sharing (S1's keyword may reuse it).
- Port source: v2 hero in `index.html` (CSS ~lines 76–100, markup ~255–262, JS ~590–727). Reuse the patch-window glitch approach; don't edit `index.html`.

## Must not touch
The common list in README. Other prologue scene files.

## Contracts it consumes
- Prologue stage layers: `ctx.layers.back` / `ctx.layers.swarm` (`{ canvas, ctx }`, fitted to the viewport, DPR ≤ 2, re-fitted before `resize`), `ctx.layers.text` and `ctx.layers.annot` (divs; scene roots live in `annot`). These persist across S0–S4, so **draw the halftone backdrop once per resize** and leave it for later scenes unless they replace it.
- `ctx.swarm` (shared pool), `halftone()` (`src/lib/halftone.js`), `roach()`.
- `tick(t, dt)` for roaming; `update(p)` decides word scale/lift/opacity and swarm density from `p`.

## Key frames
| p | Expected picture | Storyboard |

| S0 0.00 | ~420 roaches (s ≈ 5, the swarm token) roam over `meta.title` in Protest Revolution at `--fs-hero`; glitches only where a roach crosses a glyph: 6–14 px slices displaced ±6–18 px, 3 px red split. Scroll cue bottom-centre. | `ink-S0.png` |
| S0 0.80 | Exit half done (spec p 0.6–1): word ~0.9 scale, lifting, fading toward 25%; swarm slowing, thinning toward 40%. | none |

## Done when
- Roaches visibly cause letter glitches; the word stays legible (displaced area ≤ 35%); 60 fps at 1440×900.
- Roach count scales with viewport area (cap 700). Cursor flee 90 px.
- S0 p 1 hands over to S1 p 0 without a jump (S1 shows the swarm at 25% opacity, 40% count).
- QA: targets both ways, compare sheets, `node tools/qa-shell.mjs` still all PASS.
